title: Test operation with standard test cause on TypeID 104
purpose: Provide a well-formed baseline TypeID 104 test-command I-frame that reaches the intended application parser through the most plausible operational cause value, serving as a stable seed for later length and count mutations.
expected_behavior: Parser should accept the frame as a complete I-format APDU carrying a single TypeID 104 test command and either process it as a test operation or reject it cleanly according to role/configuration.
constraints_preserved: Complete IEC 60870-5-104 I-frame with 0x68 start and consistent 0x0e length.
ASDU uses TypeID 104 with VSQ 1 and one object payload, matching the issue-relevant command family while remaining well-formed.

Cause value 0x40 is chosen as a conservative test-operation analogue based on common IEC 60870 conventions; this exact octet mapping is an inferred assumption, not explicitly verified by the supplied snippets.
Message differs materially from the GHSA PoC in control bytes, cause, object bytes, and overall layout while preserving valid structure.
issue_safety_notes: Safe baseline near the issue surface: TypeID 104 is exercised, but lengths are internally consistent and the single-object declaration exactly matches the available bytes to avoid out-of-bounds reads.
